title: Add VPC control plane Terraform: upgrade/rollback hooks, peering, endpoints, SGs, Route53 automation
author: Aisha Karim
release_notes: Add Terraform modules for VPC control plane provisioning (subnets, interface endpoints, SGs, cross-account peering) and Route53 private hosted zone peering; add upgrade and rollback hooks for private-installer and Helm chart changes to support rolling upgrades across AZs; docs and integration tests included.
description: Context: Private deployments require predictable, repeatable VPC networking (subnets, interface endpoints, security groups) and a resilient upgrade path when upgrading control plane components across multi-AZ clusters. Motivation: customers running private control planes hit edge cases during upgrades (stuck route53 peering updates, transient interface endpoint flaps, SG drift across accounts) and onboarding cross-account peering was manual. This PR introduces Terraform modules, installer hooks, Helm chart updates and automation to make provisioning and upgrades reliable. Changes: 1) New terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane module that provisions subnets (multi-AZ), interface endpoints (S3, ECR, STS), security groups with least-privileged rules, and cross-account VPC peering with automated route propagation and peering acceptance. 2) Route53 private hosted zone peering automation and idempotent record management for control-plane DNS names. 3) private-installer upgrade hooks (installer/helm templates + k8s job) that run pre-upgrade checks, create temporary peering or endpoint fallbacks, and execute controlled rollbacks on failure. 4) Helm chart: values and templates to allow canary AZ upgrades and opt-in endpoint changes. 5) Integration test harness additions and a terraform plan validation workflow for CI. Testing and rollout: added unit/plan tests, integration Terraform tests (short-run) that validate peering and DNS, and a staged rollout plan in docs to enable canary upgrades per region. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve existing topologies unless new flags enabled; rollback path tested via integration tests. Docs: added docs/private/control-plane/upgrade.md with upgrade checklist and troubleshooting guidance. Impact: reduces manual work for networking teams, prevents common upgrade regressions, and supports cross-account topologies for enterprise customers.
